repo_notes.author: JacRed maintainers
repo_notes.content:
Public DeepWiki for jacred-fdb/jacred. This is not Devin Enterprise: no playbooks, secrets files, or ACU effort levels. wiki.json pages are an explicit 30-page cap (public DeepWiki maximum). Generate exactly these pages.

ROLES: Canonical operator docs are Russian Mintlify at https://docs.jacred.stream (source: docs/ with docs.json). DeepWiki is the English code-grounded twin: explain where topics live in the repo and link the matching docs.jacred.stream URLs. Do not paste install scripts, docker-compose dumps, crontab, or API tables — those belong on Mintlify.

SOURCE OF TRUTH: application code, Configuration/AppOptions.cs, Configuration/Schema/ConfigSchema.cs, Data/crontab, Data/init.yaml, Data/example.yaml, web/public/openapi.yaml. Not DeepWiki, not generated wiki text, not docs/ MDX as architecture.

Three default layers: (1) C# field initializers in AppOptions.cs when a key is absent; (2) packaged Data/init.yaml (empty secrets, opensync false, syncsport/syncspidr false); (3) Data/example.yaml (illustrative, including sample syncapi). Runtime config is CWD init.yaml or init.conf, not Data/init.yaml.

FACTS: default port 9117; listenip is any; 25 tracker slugs; apikey protects search APIs; devkey protects /dev, /cron, /jsondb, /api/v1.0/config from internet and reverse proxy; Anibelka is anonymous-only; Rutracker uses FlareSolverr Warmup (Anistar does not); RuDub and Mazepa use BencodeTo.MagnetNoTrackers; Docker image has no in-container cron — host or sidecar must call /cron/*; FileDB lives in Data/fdb with masterDb.bz; Vue SPA is web/ published to wwwroot/; OpenAPI canonical file is web/public/openapi.yaml copied manually to docs/openapi/openapi.yaml.

LAYOUT: single JacRed.csproj. Controllers/ HTTP; Application/ search and maintenance; Infrastructure/ FileDB, Trackers, Security, network; Configuration/ load and schema; Models/; web/ Vue UI; Data/ templates crontab and examples; tests/JacRed.Tests; scripts/ dry-run and build; .github/workflows/ build.yml release.yml. Compose/Docker at repo root. Mintlify root is docs/.

IGNORE as architecture: temp/, bin/, obj/, wwwroot (generated), every SVG/ico dump. Never emit real tokens, cookies, passwords, Alloha tokens, or private hosts.

When a Mintlify nav group is added in docs/docs.json, fold it into an existing wiki page or replace a leaf. Do not add a 31st page.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: English introduction to JacRed: ASP.NET Core 10 self-hosted torrent aggregator on port 9117 with FileDB, Jackett/Torznab/Prowlarr APIs, and 25 tracker parsers. How Controllers, Application, Infrastructure, and web/ cooperate. Point readers to https://docs.jacred.stream for operator docs and to child wiki pages for code maps. Do not duplicate the Russian landing page.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Map clone-and-run paths: jacred.sh, docker-compose, make publish, Data/example.yaml, Data/init.yaml. Default port 9117 and GET /health. Link Mintlify; do not paste full install scripts.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.purpose: How Configuration/ loads init.yaml / init.conf from CWD, merges AppOptions, hot-reloads ~10s. Cover AppOptions fields, ConfigSchema, /settings editor. Distinguish AppOptions C# defaults vs Data/init.yaml vs Data/example.yaml.

pages.title: Security and Access
pages.purpose: JacRedEndpointRegistry policies: Public, ApiKeyWhenConfigured, ConfigApi, DevAdmin. apikey vs devkey headers. Reverse-proxy X-Forwarded headers force devkey. Do not publish secrets.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Single-project layer diagram: Controllers, Application search, Infrastructure FileDB/trackers/security, Configuration, Models, web Vue SPA. Repository map. Operator overview stays on Mintlify.

pages.title: FileDB and FastDb
pages.purpose: Infrastructure FileDB shards under Data/fdb, masterDb.bz, FastDb in-memory index, fdbPathLevels, maxreadfile. How parsers write and search reads. No schema dump.

pages.title: Search Pipeline
pages.purpose: Application search: title/ID normalize, Alloha KP/IMDb/TMDB resolve, mergeV1, Jackett vs Torznab vs Native vs Prowlarr adapters over the same FileDB index.

pages.title: Sync
pages.purpose: Remote FileDB sync via syncapi, synctrackers, opensync, timeSync, checkpoints. Controllers and Infrastructure sync types. Starter Data/init.yaml has opensync false and empty syncapi.

pages.title: Tracks
pages.purpose: Optional tracks module: tsuri TorrServer /ffp, tracksconcurrency, tracksinterval, ffprobe metadata written into FileDB. Map controllers and workers without dumping timeouts.

pages.title: Background Jobs
pages.purpose: In-process workers vs external cron hitting /cron/{slug}. ParseAllResumeWorker (~45s) and */15 ResumeParseAll continue disk checkpoints; /health/background-jobs is in-memory only. /jsondb/save, maintenance Check. Docker has no in-container cron.

pages.title: Web UI
pages.purpose: web/ Vue 3 SPA: /, /stats, /settings. OpenAPI types via npm run gen:api. Built into wwwroot. Cloudflare Workers deployment is a separate origin proxy.

pages.title: Trackers Overview
pages.purpose: Catalog of 25 slugs under Infrastructure/Trackers. Sync clusters, auth, magnet policy. Link child cluster pages. Do not create one wiki page per tracker.

pages.title: Trio Cluster
pages.purpose: Code map for rutracker, kinozal, rutor, nnmclub, megapeer, toloka, torrentby, anibelka, korsars, ultradox: parse + UpdateTasksParse + ParseAllTask, Data/temp cycle checkpoints, ResumeParseAll after restart. Rutracker FlareSolverr crawlUrl lane.

pages.title: Rutor-style and ParseLatest
pages.purpose: anibelka (anon only), korsars, ultradox (search Referer). Trio plus ParseLatest. Magnet and auth gotchas from the tracker skill.

pages.title: Page-range Trackers
pages.purpose: mazepa, lostfilm, selezen, baibako, animelayer, anidub, aniliberty, rudub. parseFrom/parseTo or dedicated mazepa crawl. RuDub/Mazepa MagnetNoTrackers. Baibako parser has a known TODO.

pages.title: Daily Parse Trackers
pages.purpose: anistar (host/alias, not FlareSolverr), anifilm, leproduction, viruseproject. limit_page daily parse. Map Controllers/Cron and Infrastructure/Trackers.

pages.title: API Trackers
pages.purpose: bitru, knaben, subsplease: official JSON APIs, hourly latest plus checkpointed backfill. Prefer site JSON over HTML scrape.

pages.title: Deployment
pages.purpose: Repo artifacts: Dockerfile, GHCR ghcr.io/jacred-fdb/jacred, jacred.sh systemd, win-x64 zip JacRed.exe, reverse proxy, Cloudflare Workers UI. Link Mintlify; do not paste compose files.

pages.title: Cron and Scheduling
pages.purpose: Data/crontab and Data/run-job.sh as source of truth. Stagger minutes, max_time for long crawls. Host-side cron for Docker. Map Controllers/Cron.

pages.title: Operations
pages.purpose: Maintenance Check/Status, JacRed maintain CLI, troubleshooting (health, journalctl, FileDB). Mintlify holds operator procedures.

pages.title: API Overview
pages.purpose: Where routes are declared: Controllers with [Route]. Jackett /api/v2.0, Native /api/v1.0/torrents, Torznab /torznab/api, Prowlarr /api/v1. Hand-written API MDX plus generated OpenAPI on Mintlify are canonical.

pages.title: Search APIs
pages.purpose: Map Jackett, Torznab, Prowlarr, Native controllers to Mintlify pages. Do not duplicate parameter lists.

pages.title: Management APIs
pages.purpose: Config, stats, sync, cron, health, /dev FileDB tools. DevAdmin warnings. Never document live keys.

pages.title: OpenAPI and Swagger
pages.purpose: Canonical web/public/openapi.yaml, Mintlify copy docs/openapi/openapi.yaml, npm run gen:api for web types, /swagger and /openapi.yaml at runtime. Manual copy policy.

pages.title: Development and Testing
pages.purpose: make publish, tests/JacRed.Tests, web Playwright, scripts/dry_run_{slug}_parser.py, Node 22. Map CI build.yml. Do not treat CI YAML as runtime config.

pages.title: Tracker Parser Patterns
pages.purpose: How to add a slug: Parser + SyncService + Cron controller + DI + ConfigSchema + crontab + OpenAPI TrackerSlug + docs. Clusters from .cursor/skills/jacred-tracker-parser. Unique FDB URLs. No half-wired trackers.

pages.title: FlareSolverr and Network
pages.purpose: Infrastructure network: FlareSolverr for Rutracker, proxy/globalproxy, Worker alias. Not used by Anistar. Docker compose sidecar URL http://flaresolverr:8191/v1.

pages.title: Clients and Integrations
pages.purpose: How Lampa (Jackett JSON), Lampac JacRed module, Sonarr/Radarr Torznab, Prowlarr, AIOStreams consume APIs. Server-side URLs only; do not copy Lampac module source.

pages.title: Docs Sites Mintlify DeepWiki
pages.purpose: Two surfaces: docs/ Mintlify (docs.json, MDX, content path /docs) and .devin/wiki.json public DeepWiki (30-page cap). Agents: docs/AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/mintlify-docs.mdc, .cursor/agents/mintlify-docsops.md, .agents/skills/mintlify*. DeepWiki is not a source of truth and must not copy MDX.

pages.title: Repository CI and Publish
pages.purpose: JacRed.csproj, scripts/build.sh, make publish. Workflows: build.yml, release.yml, reusable-docker-build.yml. GHCR image ghcr.io/jacred-fdb/jacred. Release zips jacred-linux-* and jacred-win-x64. Do not treat CI YAML as runtime config.

page_notes.content: CI lives in .github/workflows/. Docker image: ghcr.io/jacred-fdb/jacred. Releases: https://github.com/jacred-fdb/jacred/releases
